# Codester

> > Codester is a digital marketplace for buying and selling PHP scripts, WordPress themes, app templates, plugins, and design assets.

Codester serves as a comprehensive code marketplace where developers and entrepreneurs can discover, purchase, and sell ready-made software solutions across web, mobile, and blockchain platforms. The platform features curated collections, trending products, community forums, and opportunities for sellers to monetize their work.

## Key Topics

- PHP Scripts
- WordPress Themes
- App Templates
- WooCommerce
- React/ReactJS
- Flutter
- Android Development
- iOS Development
- Web Templates
- WordPress Plugins
- Source Code
- Mobile Development
- Admin Dashboards
- Digital Assets
- Code Marketplace

## Marketplace & Browse

- [Codester Home](https://www.codester.com): Main marketplace hub to browse and purchase PHP scripts, WordPress themes, app templates, plugins and graphics
- [Top Scripts & Code](https://www.codester.com/popular/43/scripts-code): Top 20 popular PHP, JavaScript and web app source code scripts
- [Top App Templates & Source Codes](https://www.codester.com/popular/44/app-templates-source-codes): Top 20 app templates for iOS, Android, Flutter, React and Unity
- [Top Website Templates & Themes](https://www.codester.com/popular/46/website-templates-themes): Top 20 website templates for WordPress, HTML, Shopify and WooCommerce
- [Top Plugins & Extensions](https://www.codester.com/popular/45/plugins-extensions): Top 20 plugins for WordPress, WooCommerce, Magento and other platforms
- [Top Graphics Assets](https://www.codester.com/popular/57/graphics): Top 20 graphics assets: logos, icons, UI kits, game assets and mockups
- [Collections](https://www.codester.com/collections): User-curated collections of scripts, templates, themes and design assets

## Deals & Promotions

- [Free Files of the Week](https://www.codester.com/free): Weekly free downloads of PHP scripts, templates, plugins and graphics
- [Flash Sale](https://www.codester.com/sale): Flash sale with discounts on scripts, templates, themes and graphics

## For Sellers

- [Sell Your Work](https://www.codester.com/info/seller): Seller signup and information for publishing PHP, WordPress and app products
- [Affiliate Program](https://www.codester.com/info/affiliate): Codester affiliate program with referral commissions and marketing materials

## Community & Resources

- [Forums](https://www.codester.com/forum): Community forums for seller support, marketplace help and technical discussions
- [Blog](https://www.codester.com/blog): Blog covering web development, AI tools, mobile apps and business guides
